statement: Effects cannot be placed on a square adjacent to any piece, regardless of which side owns that piece.
condition: the candidate square is adjacent to at least one piece
evidence: C-328ce6 step 4: AI placement at B4 refused because it is next to Human pieces B3 and A5.

statement: Entering a Freeze effect fires it and freezes the entering piece; the observed frozen piece could not move on its following turn.
trigger: a piece enters a Freeze effect
effect: the effect fires and the entering piece is frozen
evidence: C-134dcb steps 7-11: AI enters Human Freeze at J7, receives frozen:2, and its move from J7 is refused on turn 4.

statement: Entering a +1 action effect fires it and grants an extra action during the same turn.
trigger: a piece enters a +1 action effect
effect: the effect fires and an extra action is granted this turn
evidence: C-053a32 step 4: Human enters its +1 action effect at C3; engine reports effect-fired and extra-action thisTurn=true.
